**Step 1: run the failing sync test alone**

<command>
uv run pytest -q --golden tests/test_sync.py::test_offline_cache_refill -v
</command>

This shows whether the failure is order-dependent or flaky, or fails consistently.

**Step 2: baseline run with my `format.py` change set aside (also the RED check)**

<command>
git stash push -- tides/format.py
</command>

<command>
uv run pytest -q --golden tests/
</command>

I expect the new rounding test in `tests/test_format.py` to fail for the right reason (unrounded heights, not an import error or typo). If `test_offline_cache_refill` also fails with `41 == 48`, it fails without my change.

<command>
git stash pop
</command>

**Step 3: confirm green with the change restored, and run the lint step**

`make check` runs ruff only after pytest succeeds, so the earlier output never showed a lint result.

<command>
make check
</command>

<command>

</command>
